name: Fiberon PA6-GF25 @Qidi X-Plus 4 0.6 nozzle
filament_notes:
Fiberon manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 100 C for 10 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Warp-Free nylon: keep build plate AND ambient air below 50 C (open chamber doors); no enclosure. All-metal hotend + hardened/ruby nozzle (brass nozzle life ~9 h per TDS). Very hygroscopic: print from a heated dryer, store <20% RH. TDS chamber temperature: 'Room Temp.' Moisture-condition parts after annealing. Grey only. 0.5 kg and 3 kg spools (no 1 kg). Fan OFF. Support: PolyDissolve S1. HDT up to 191 C annealed.
Source: https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0548/7299/7945/files/TDS_FIBERON_PA6-GF25_V1.1_EN.pdf?v=1733846089
